behavior.fieldSemantics: Costs, time, prerequisites, progress and phase derive from authoritative state. Direct prerequisite counts and broader explanatory facts are distinct. Source example campaign values are not production defaults.
behavior.permissions: Single-player, authenticated campaign. Disabled, disconnected, uncertain, proposed, blocked, planned and completed states cannot commission. The engine revalidates every order.
behavior.transitions: Selection never commissions. Pending orders retain the acknowledged phase; only an accepted snapshot produces Commissioned or Complete. Authorized may offer a separate neutral discussion action.
behavior.navigation: Compact node selection opens a detail focus view after acknowledgement. Back or Escape restores the retained graph and invoking control. Passive updates do not reopen the view.
behavior.keyboard: A real button selects each card with Enter or Space. Focus and selection remain distinct. Pending or unavailable transport uses aria-disabled without dropping card focus. Unscaled cards and action controls have at least a 44px target; zoomed graph overviews retain an unscaled keyboard selector.
behavior.errors: Expose transport/rejection errors without an optimistic success receipt. Local preview explicitly disables steward messaging instead of pretending an AI response exists.
behavior.scrolling: Keep the same centered inspector in a scrollable compact sheet. Long titles and descriptions remain available in full; graph text may be bounded. No document horizontal overflow at 390px.
behavior.motion: System and explicit reduced-motion preferences apply; no animation gates a command. Keep graph position, focus and selection stable during progress updates.
behavior.noWrite: The hermetic lab imports only presentation components. It has no campaign transport, credentials, storage, network writes or Figma writes. Reference content is chosen locally and is never uploaded.
behavior.privacy: Source IDs, versions, raw metadata, original reference content, images, comparisons and bindings remain outside Git. The existing public ship glyph is an explicit user-selected difference.
